ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap 222], as amended including the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2022 (UBO record-keeping obligations); Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 11 of 2022; Financial Dealers Act [Cap 238]; VFSC AML/CFT Rulebook (2022); obligations to maintain beneficial ownership registers with licensed registered agents and to provide government access via the VFSC and the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified True Copy of Passport (each director and UBO at 25% or greater ownership)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing authority in the UBO's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Vanuatu is NOT a contracting party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention; document must be notarized, authenticated by the origin country's Ministry of Foreign Affairs, then legalized by a Vanuatu embassy, honorary consulate, or authorized legalization office)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of Residential Address (utility bill or bank statement issued within the last 90 days)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or licensed bank in the country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (same chain as above; corroborated by the Vanuatu licensed registered agent's certified cross-check under VFSC Rulebook requirements)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter for UBOs and Directors (AML/KYC standard, dated within 90 days)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Financial institution maintaining the UBO's primary account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (or authenticated by the issuing bank if acceptable to the Vanuatu registered agent under VFSC AML/CFT Rulebook Rule 4.2)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Compliance (post-incorporation, for Stripe, Amazon Pay, and foreign bank onboarding)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: VFSC-issued original; for use abroad, notarization by a Vanuatu notary, authentication by the Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and consular legalization by the destination country's mission (no apostille applicable)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Registered Agent and Registered Office Address (statutory requirement for the International Company license)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed Vanuatu Registered Agent (VFSC-licensed corporate services provider)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (agent's wet-ink certification plus consular chain if required by payment platform or acquiring bank KYC)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based screening of directors, shareholders, authorized signatories, and all beneficial owners (25% or control-based) against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, HM Treasury Consolidated List, and domestic Vanuatu sanctions and FIU advisories. PEPs, including family members and close associates, require enhanced due diligence, source-of-wealth verification, and senior management approval prior to incorporation. Continuous transaction monitoring is required under the AML/CFT Act 2022 and the VFSC AML/CFT Rulebook; suspicious transaction reports must be filed with the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit; CDD and UBO records must be retained for at least five years after the business relationship ends.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Corporate Registry - Online Name Reservation Portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be rendered in Latin script using English and/or French words; non-Latin source characters (e.g., Chinese, Cyrillic, Arabic) must be phonetically transliterated into Latin script; the name must clearly convey the legal form and avoid Bislama-only constructs; prior written consent from the relevant regulator is required for names containing restricted tokens.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A written extension request must be lodged with the VFSC Registrar before the initial 30-day window expires; extension is generally granted for up to 60 additional days at the Registrar's discretion. Upon rejection, the applicant may file a written administrative appeal with the Registrar of International Companies within 14 calendar days of the refusal notice, attaching corrected name options or, for sensitive tokens, written consent from the relevant governmental or regulatory body. If the Registrar upholds the rejection, judicial review may be sought in the Supreme Court of Vanuatu under the International Companies Act within 30 days of the final administrative decision.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual operational office is permissible for this low-risk digital e-commerce industry (Amazon Pay and Stripe payment rails) because no physical manufacturing facility in Vanuatu is planned; however, the statutory registered office must be a physical address in Vanuatu maintained by the licensed registered agent, and a general non-serviced virtual office cannot satisfy the International Company statutory registered-office requirement.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate: approximately 5% estimated likelihood of an unannounced VFSC physical inspection within the first 12 months for a low-risk entity; probability rises to approximately 15% if the registered agent's compliance file is flagged or if UBO documentation is incomplete; annual compliance review is recommended.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act No. 32 of 1993 (as amended), ss. 4-10 and ss. 47-52; International Companies (Registration) Regulations 1993; Business Licence Act [Cap. 22] for operational licensing.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – International Companies Division, Port Vila, Vanuatu.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association together with Form IC-1 (Application for Registration as an International Company); issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation by the VFSC Registrar.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for a Vanuatu International Company. The Memorandum must state an authorized share capital (commonly USD 100,000 divided into shares of no par value). Paid-up capital is determined solely by the subscribers' allotment; no escrow account or capital deposit is required at incorporation under the International Companies Act 1993.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the share subscription held by the initial subscriber be and is hereby accepted, and that the Directors subscribe to and take up the shares allotted in accordance with the Company's Memorandum and Articles of Association. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the Company in Vanuatu, as maintained by the licensed registered agent, be and is hereby adopted as the Company's statutory address for service of process and official notices. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [Name] be and is hereby appointed Managing Director, [Name] be and is hereby appointed Company Secretary, and [Name] be and is hereby appointed Financial Officer, each to act with full authority under the International Companies Act, 1993, until otherwise determined by the Board.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Division through a licensed registered agent in Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct an internal name search on the VFSC register of international companies; reserve the proposed name with the licensed agent; ensure the name does not contain restricted words such as 'Bank', 'Trust', 'Insurance', or 'Assurance' without VFSC approval; obtain a written name-reservation confirmation before preparing constitutional documents.
required_dossiers: Entity structure and business-scope description for name relevance
Certified passport copy of each founder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused or flagged, file a fresh reservation with an alternative distinguishing name; a written appeal may be submitted to the VFSC Registrar for reconsideration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarization of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent / notary public in Port Vila, Vanuatu
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association under ss. 4 and 5 of the International Companies Act 1993, specifying authorized share capital, registered-agent details, and an object clause limited to the licensed business scope. Execute the documents by the initial subscriber(s), initial each page, and notarize the execution page before a Vanuatu notary or an overseas notary with apostille certification.
required_dossiers: Subscriber consent forms and director consents
Certified passport copies and proof of residential address for all first officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC queries the clauses, restructure the object clause and re-execute the constitutional documents; a notary correction certificate may be filed to cure execution defects.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Registration Application to VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Division (counter or licensed-agent e-filing channel)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge the completed Form IC-1 Application for Registration together with the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association, director consents, registered-agent acceptance letter, and proof of payment of the VFSC registration fee. Submit through the licensed agent's e-filing platform or the physical counter at VFSC headquarters in Port Vila; retain the stamped receipt bearing the application reference number.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
VFSC fee payment receipt for USD 250 government fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: VFSC may query within 14 days; submit a written reply with supplementary KYC/AML declarations. If the application lapses, re-file with a fresh application fee and request priority processing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Formation Records
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon VFSC approval, the Registrar enters the company in the International Companies Register and issues the Certificate of Incorporation. Verify the certificate for the exact corporate name, date of incorporation, and unique registration number. The company may then adopt an official common seal if desired and complete internal formation records such as the share ledger and seal register.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: For clerical errors on the certificate, submit to VFSC a written request for a certificate of correction or a duplicate certificate together with the prescribed replacement fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Activation of Registered Office and Registered Agent in Vanuatu
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-licensed registered agent in Port Vila / VFSC register update
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Confirm in writing that the licensed registered agent in Vanuatu maintains the company's registered office address. File the registered-office and agent details on the VFSC register; ensure the address is a physical location in Vanuatu, not a post-office box, and that the agent accepts legal process on the company's behalf.
required_dossiers: First board resolution adopting the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent resigns, appoint a substitute VFSC-licensed agent and file the new registered-office notice with VFSC within the statutory period to avoid striking-off or deregistration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting and Officer Appointments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors acting by written resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting or pass a written first board resolution to subscribe for shares, adopt the registered office, appoint the managing director, company secretary, and financial officer, ratify banking signatories, and approve issuance of share certificates. Record the minutes or written resolutions and maintain them at the registered office; file any officer changes with VFSC within the required window.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a resolution is procedurally invalid, a subsequent board ratification resolution will cure the defect; for late filing of officer changes, submit the filing with a compliance deposit and an explanatory letter to VFSC.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) and Department of Industry, Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Co-operatives, jointly with municipal Business Licence offices under the Business Licence Act [Cap. 22].
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business Licence (Manufacturing – Wooden Toys) under the Business Licence Act [Cap. 22]; Foreign Investment Registration Certificate issued by VIPA if any founder is a non-resident.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC) under the Environmental Protection and Conservation Act [Cap. 217].
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 2 (Low-Impact Manufacturing) – preliminary environmental registration and screening; no full EIA Report required unless the facility applies solvent-based coatings exceeding 1 tonne/year VOC, discharges process wastewater off-site, or is located outside an approved industrial/business zoning area.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero untreated industrial effluent; any process wastewater from sawing or coating must achieve pH 6.5-8.5, TSS not exceeding 50 mg/L, and BOD5 not exceeding 30 mg/L before discharge. Coating solvents limited to a maximum VOC content of 420 g/L or the use of water-based non-toxic varnish certified for children's products. Sawdust and wood shavings must be collected, bagged, and disposed at a licensed municipal landfill as non-hazardous waste.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Vanuatu Fire and Rescue Service covering emergency exits, extinguisher placement, and alarm systems; Building Occupancy / structural-load inspection certificate from the Public Works Department under the Vanuatu Building Code; and workplace clearance from the Occupational Health and Safety Unit of the Department of Labour confirming dust extraction, ventilation, machine guarding, and worker safety protocols.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRC) under the Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; operational customs portal via ASYCUDA World; company registration and annual maintenance through Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), www.vfsc.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: 1) Incorporate International Company (IC) under International Companies Act Cap 222 via licensed VFSC agent; Certificate of Incorporation with company number constitutes the statutory identifier. 2) Register with VRC/ASYCUDA to obtain Importer/Exporter Code for customs declarations (no TIN/VAT ID exists because the IC is outside the income-tax and any VAT net). 3) If a physical office or factory is occupied, obtain municipal business license (Port Vila/Luganville); this is a regulatory fee separate from tax exemption. 4) File annual return and pay VFSC annual license fee; no tax filings required.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone — non-resident International Company wholly exempt from Vanuatu income tax, withholding tax, capital gains tax, stamp duty and any indirect tax under International Companies Act Cap 222 s.209 (exemption) and s.7(4) (prohibition on domestic business with residents).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None available under domestic law — Vanuatu has no check-the-box, CFM or hybrid-mismatch election. The only conceivable 'election' is re-registration as an ordinary company under Companies Act Cap 191, which would surrender exempt status and is therefore disfavoured; alternatively the IC may be redomiciled to/from another jurisdiction under the International Companies Act.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT/GST/SUT in force — operative indirect tax is the Vanuatu Customs Import Duty (tariff) under the Customs Act Cap 90; Value Added Tax Act 2023 has been enacted but implementation is deferred and not in effect.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable (no VAT effective); the deferred VAT Act provides a VUV 5,000,000 registration threshold with compulsory registration for cross-border service suppliers.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No e-invoicing or digital stamping mandate. Export/import declarations are mandatory through ASYCUDA World single-window; each declaration receives an electronic customs declaration number (MRN-equivalent), which functions as the only fiscal clearance artefact.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Inapplicable in form because there is no VAT; Vanuatu exports are inherently tax-neutral (zero-rated by absence of any levy). The IC may lawfully export 100% of production free of duty and indirect tax. To avoid import duty on beechwood raw material, secure a temporary-inward-processing/immediate-export concession from VRC with a 12-month export completion deadline; otherwise the applicable tariff (generally 15% ad valorem for HS 9503 toys) becomes payable.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: ASYCUDA World Electronic Customs Export Declaration (VAN-142)
Bill of Lading (or House Air Waybill for airfreight)
Commercial Invoice in English with HS 9503.00.00 and ISIC 3240 descriptors
Inward Remittance Certificate / bank credit advice (only where counterparty financing or foreign-exchange control checks are invoked; no statutory export repatriation deadline exists in Vanuatu)
Certificate of Origin (optional but recommended for tariff preferences in Australia, NZ and the EU)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Customs Act Cap 90 penalties — false export declarations attract fines up to VUV 1,000,000 and/or 12 months imprisonment, forfeiture of goods and demand of 30% of the value; abuse of temporary importation relief triggers full payment of duty on the value of the diverted goods; breach of the IC's non-trading-with-residents covenant may cause VFSC to revoke exempt status and expose historical transactions to taxation (retroactive clawback), although no income-tax base currently exists.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) under the Banking Act [Cap. 129] and the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 64]; the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) registers and supervises International Companies under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222].
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vanuatu Vatu (VUV) is not a freely convertible hard currency; the RBV operates a managed exchange-rate regime with the VUV linked to a basket of major trading-partner currencies. Current-account transactions (goods, services, trade disbursements, profit and royalty remittances) are routinely approved by authorised dealer banks under delegated powers, subject to documentary verification of the underlying commercial transaction. Capital-account items, including external borrowings and cross-currency principal swaps, require prior RBV approval or authorised-dealer approval under standing Exchange Control Notices. An International Company (IC) is, as a general rule, tax-exempt on all offshore income and faces no Vanuatu withholding, income, capital gains, or estate taxes, so dividend and profit remittance hurdles are fiscal-nil; the operative constraint is the thin VUV spot market and settlement timing. The entity should therefore maintain dual VUV/USD accounts, denominate e-commerce settlement in USD, and convert to VUV only for permitted local expenditures.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 64] and applicable delegated Exchange Control Notice issued by the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu, export proceeds must be repatriated to a Vanuatu-authorized dealer bank and received within six (6) months from the date of export. Supporting evidence per shipment comprises the commercial invoice, bill of lading or airway bill, packing list, and the bank's inward remittance advice. Vanuatu imposes no mandatory statutory ratio compelling conversion of export receipts into VUV; exporters may retain foreign currency in approved Foreign Currency Accounts (USD/EUR/AUD) held with an authorized dealer. Voluntary conversion to VUV is optional and executed at the daily RBV reference rate. Failure to repatriate within the statutory timeline may expose the IC to enforcement directions or penalties under the Exchange Control Act; therefore, monthly reconciliation of Amazon Pay and Stripe payout reports to incoming MT103 credits is required.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_regulation_notes: Not part of the schema-mandated element; no action required.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: USD Foreign Currency Account; VUV Operational Account; Corporate E-commerce Settlement Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (BSP) Vanuatu Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: VUV/USD Operational Account; Trade Finance and Commercial LC Account
VUV/USD Corporate Operational Account; Corporate Treasury Lines

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low-to-Medium. Vanuatu has no domestic e-money institution (EMI) licensing regime, and the RBV does not regulate foreign EMIs operating into Vanuatu; therefore, an off-shore EMI cannot serve as the IC's sole treasury anchor. Offshore digital cross-border EMIs (e.g., Airwallex, Currenxie, and similar regulated payment firms) will accept a Vanuatu International Company only under their internal risk appetite, which frequently classifies offshore ICs as heightened-risk due to opaque substance and tax-haven associations. Amazon Pay and Stripe payout rails cannot directly settle into a VUV domestic account in all cases; a practical architecture is a Stripe/Amazon settlement node held in a supported market (US, UK, or HK) linked to a treasury gateway, with daily sweeping via SWIFT MT103 into ANZ/BSP Vanuatu. The domestic operational account must remain the compliance anchor, with the EMI used as a collection-and-payout utility only, never as a repository of capital or export proceeds.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical appearance is the default expectation for at least one director, beneficial owner, or the authorised signatory during initial onboarding at ANZ, BSP, and BRED in Port Vila, driven by Money Laundering Prevention Act obligations and the bank's risk-based KYC. Remote opening may be permitted at bank discretion where the client is low-risk (as assessed for e-commerce physical-goods manufacturers), provided that the bank accepts (i) a notarised or apostilled power of attorney in favour of a Vanuatu licensed registered agent; (ii) certified true copies of the passport and proof of address of each director and UBO; (iii) an executed video-interview with the Relationship Manager; and (iv) original board resolutions. The materially safer and faster route for the offshore IC is one principal director or a delegated corporate officer attending a Port Vila branch in person, completing the interview, and lodging certified documentation; follow-on account signatories can then be added remotely under the corporate mandate.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore shell classification: Vanuatu IC perceived as mailbox entity with no local substance or operational footprint
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Incorporation under International Companies Act Cap. 222; Certificate of Good Standing issued by VFSC; registered-agent agreement and current registered-office address; board resolution confirming real commercial purpose (procurement of beechwood in production country, fulfilment to Amazon FBA and EU/US distribution, and Vanuatu treasury management); organisational chart; recent management accounts or a cash-flow projection; photographs or lease evidence of any Vanuatu administrative office; and a written substance memorandum describing local agent, signatories, and procurement flow.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity: nominee shareholders, bearer-shares concerns, or undisclosed natural persons
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Up-to-date Beneficial Ownership Register maintained under sections 90–93 of the International Companies Act and provided confidentially to the bank; statutory declarations of beneficial ownership; passport and proof-of-address of every natural-person UBO; share register and shareholders' ledger; confirmation that no bearer shares are outstanding; director register with full identification data.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unverified source of funds for initial capital injection into the IC
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Six to twelve months of personal bank statements of each subscribing shareholder; tax clearance certificate or no-tax-due confirmation from the shareholder's home revenue authority; notarised subscription agreement for equity or loan agreement for shareholder advances; evidence of shareholder wealth (salary slips, sale-and-purchase agreements, inheritance documents, asset valuations); board resolution authorising the capital injection and recording the contribution nature.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: E-commerce credits from Stripe and Amazon Pay regarded as unexplained third-party payments or commingling risk
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed merchant service agreements with Stripe and Amazon; a written payment-flow schematic from buyer checkout to payout into the settlement account; monthly payout statements and settlement reports; logs from the fulfilment partner or 3PL warehouse; shipping and delivery tracking history; segregation of all market-place receipts from director-related or affiliate transfers; and a formal treasury policy stating that only documented trade receivables pass through the account.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions, PEP, or adverse-media flags against any UBO, director, or counterparty
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Passport scans of all directors, UBOs, and signatories; independent sanctions-screening results from a reputable database; signed non-PEP declarations; negative-media and adverse-news search output; a list of all material commercial counterparties (wood suppliers, finishing vendor, freight forwarders and FBA logistics providers) with supporting registration documents; and a letter from the Vanuatu registered agent confirming that no suspicious activity has been reported to the VFSC in respect of the IC.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound routing is an SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's home-country bank to the IC's USD-denominated account at ANZ Bank (Vanuatu) Limited or BSP Vanuatu Limited. The wire must carry a purpose code consistent with 'equity subscription' or 'shareholder loan' (e.g., code GF for equity injection under the originating bank's taxonomy, or a narrative coded 'IC Capital Contribution, International Companies Act Cap. 222'). The bank file must contain: (1) board resolution authorising issuance of shares or the shareholder-advance agreement; (2) subscription agreement with per-share price and number of shares; (3) the VFSC registration certificate and registered-agent letter; (4) UBO and source-of-funds evidence as escalated in the AML/KYC dossier; and (5) an instruction to hold the funds in USD rather than convert to VUV, ensuring preservation of the e-commerce working-capital base. Where the capital is received in VUV, the authorised dealer executes conversion at the daily RBV reference rate and records the trade for balance-of-payments reporting.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For raw beechwood supply, non-toxic finishing materials, third-party cutting and sanding, and fulfilment logistics: (i) payments under USD 250,000 per transaction are executed as USD SWIFT MT103 out of the ANZ/BSP account, with the beneficiary bank, BIC, and account number validated against the supplier's bank confirmation; (ii) first-time or high-value supplier relationships are settled by an irrevocable, sight commercial letter of credit issued by BSP or ANZ, payable against invoice, bill of lading/airway bill, packing list, certificate of non-toxic paint compliance, and inspection certificate if applicable; (iii) recurring small-ticket disbursements, including Amazon FBA warehousing fees and Stripe processing fees, may be swept via a corporate card or the approved EMI gateway with monthly reconciliation back to the core account. Each outbound transfer requires the underlying purchase order and invoice, the FX deal confirmation if VUV/USD conversion is involved, and the dealer-bank trade-data capture record required by the RBV; the six-month export-proceeds rule must be monitored so that any prepayment or delayed-payment manufacturing advance is declared and matched.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable outright VUV/USD and VUV/AUD forward contracts with an RBV-licensed authorised dealer (ANZ, BSP, BRED), available only for confirmed commercial exposure and typically up to 12-month tenors under an ISDA master or bank foreign-exchange agreement.

Offshore Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) in USD/VUV executed with an international bank or broker, permissible to hedge balance-sheet receivables and committed e-commerce payouts where the domestic deliverable market is illiquid; documentation must evidence the underlying Amazon/Stripe settlement flow.

Plain-vanilla cross-currency swaps (USD/VUV or USD/AUD) between authorised dealers and the IC, used to hedge intercompany loan balances and multi-currency capital structures; principal exchange is subject to RBV capital-transaction approval and board authorisation.

Spot FX conversions executed at the RBV daily reference rate as the operational conversion rail for receipts and disbursements, typically executed within a 1-to-5-business-day window to balance rate risk and settlement urgency.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual International Company Government Renewal Fee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before the anniversary of the issuance of the certificate of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A late fee of 10% per month or part of a month is applied, capped at 50% of the unpaid fee; continued non-payment for six months may result in administrative strike-off, after which the assets of the company vest in the Government of Vanuatu.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Registered Agent Confirmation of Corporate Registers and Beneficial Ownership Records
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Registered Agent; records to be made available to the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission upon demand
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually at the anniversary of incorporation and within 14 days of any share transfer or change of directors, members, registered office, or registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No direct government filing fee; failure to maintain accurate statutory registers or current beneficial ownership records breaches the International Companies Act and VFSC AML/CFT Rules, exposing the company to enforcement action, fines, and potential strike-off if the registered agent resigns.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit requirement exists for a Vanuatu International Company. No financial statements, auditor appointment, or audit report is required to be filed with VFSC. A voluntary audit may be commissioned by directors, shareholders, lenders, or investors, but no statutory threshold triggers mandatory audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutory accounting framework is prescribed under the International Companies Act; accounting records must be sufficient to show and explain transactions and disclose with reasonable accuracy the financial position of the company. IFRS may be adopted voluntarily for management or external reporting purposes.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The licensed registered agent must identify and verify all members, directors, and ultimate beneficial owners at incorporation and conduct an annual due diligence refresh at each anniversary of incorporation. Any share transfer must be reflected in the Register of Members and the beneficial ownership schedule within 14 days, with a signed confirmation obtained from the controlling shareholder or ultimate beneficial owner before registration of the transfer.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not applicable (no statutory audit); voluntary audit fee market range US$2,500 - US$5,500 per engagement

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: International Companies (ICs) under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] are statutorily exempt from all income tax, corporate tax, capital gains tax, and withholding taxes imposed by Vanuatu. No income tax statute applies; the only recurring annual fiscal charge is the flat annual government licence fee payable to the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC). Exports of goods (including wooden Montessori blocks) are zero-rated for VAT purposes under the Value Added Tax Act [Cap 245], preserving neutral VAT treatment for Amazon and Stripe settlement flows.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC Annual Return for International Companies under Section 86, International Companies Act [Cap 222]; filed via the VFSC online registry portal or through the licensed registered agent in Port Vila.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within one calendar month after each anniversary of the company's date of incorporation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company name and VFSC registration number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the exact name as shown on the certificate of incorporation; foreign entities may register under English names only.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Date of incorporation and current anniversary date.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Compute the anniversary from the certificate date; non-resident owners need not appear personally to file.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office in Vanuatu (street address in Port Vila or Luganville).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be the physical office of the registered agent; P.O. boxes alone are not acceptable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered agent name and licence number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only a VFSC-licensed agent may act; the agent countersigns the return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Directors and company secretary names, residential addresses, and nationality.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are permitted; no local residency requirement applies to the IC.
A non-resident beneficial owner holding 100% is permissible; declare beneficial ownership details for the VFSC beneficial ownership register.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorised and issued share capital denomination and amount.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: May be expressed in any currency, typically USD; no minimum paid-up capital is mandatory.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the IC has not carried on business with Vanuatu residents and has no assets in Vanuatu (unless otherwise licensed).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Exports of goods to overseas customers via Amazon Pay and Stripe fall outside 'resident business' and are lawful without a local business licence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of tax-exempt status under Section 4(2) of the International Companies Act.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm that no Vanuatu income, corporate, or withholding tax liability arose during the period.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts a prescribed monetary penalty under the International Companies (Fees) Regulations (initial surcharge plus per-day accumulation) for each month or part of a month of default; persistent non-filing leads to VFSC strike-off and deregistration, forfeiture of limited liability protection, and disqualification orders against directors.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu maintains no comprehensive double taxation agreements (DTAs); therefore no treaty relief protocol is available or required for outbound dividends. Because the statutory dividend withholding rate is zero in Vanuatu, a foreign shareholder receives distributions gross without deduction, and no Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) application is necessary in the source jurisdiction. A TRC (certificate of tax residence) is not issued for ICs since they are not taxable residents under an income tax law; if a shareholder's home jurisdiction requires proof of tax paid, the appropriate document is the VFSC certificate of incorporation and the annual tax-exemption declaration (Box 9).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory rate for royalties and interest paid by an International Company to non-residents; no treaty rate applies given the absence of DTAs. Payments for trademarks, patents, and intercompany debt interest are made gross with no Vanuatu withholding.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable - no corporate income tax and no transfer pricing legislation is in force; no Vatu-denominated threshold triggers Local File or Master File preparation for International Companies.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu does not impose a separate Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) statute applicable to ICs. However, the International Companies Act requires a substantive registered office and a licensed registered agent within Vanuatu, and the VFSC conducts AML/CFT and beneficial-ownership oversight under the Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act No. 5 of 2022. The IC must maintain local governance records, hold board minutes reflecting real decision-making, and avoid conducting business with Vanuatu residents. ICs engaged in genuine foreign-facing manufacturing-trading models (such as sale of baby Montessori wooden blocks to overseas markets) satisfy the ordinary substance expectations of the VFSC and Global Forum on Transparency.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the IC with no commercial purpose, no foreign trading activity, no physical or operational presence, and utilising the entity solely as a bank account vehicle while Amazon/Stripe transactions are routed through nominee intermediaries.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC refusal of annual renewal, strike-off and deregistration under the International Companies Act; adverse reporting to the Global Forum and FATF-style peer review mechanisms; freezing of settlement proceeds by payment processors upon adverse finding.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly allow the entity to function as an empty shell may face compliance orders, civil restitution actions, disqualification from managing any VFSC-licensed entity, and travel bans imposed by the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit pending investigation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC sells its wooden block products to customers resident in Vanuatu or holds physical inventory in Vanuatu without first obtaining a local business licence under the Business Licence Act [Cap 238].
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Cancellation of the international company status, revocation of the tax exemption, monetary penalties per licence offence, and forfeiture of trading profits derived from the unauthorised local activity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are jointly and severally liable for the unlicensed trading profits and may be prosecuted criminally, with fines and imprisonment of up to 12 months for continuing contravention.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML/CFT Breach and Beneficial Ownership Non-Disclosure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to declare the true non-resident beneficial owner, obstruction of the VFSC beneficial ownership register, or processing Amazon/Stripe settlement funds through the IC without adequate source-of-funds verification records.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines and penal sanctions under the Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act No. 5 of 2022; VFSC may impose monetary penalties, suspend the registered agent, and place the IC under regulatory supervision.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the registered agent face personal criminal liability, civil restitution of laundered value, travel restrictions, and custodial sentences for wilful breach of reporting obligations.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Submitting a signed annual return (Box 8 or Box 9) containing materially false statements that the IC engaged in no Vanuatu resident business or deliberately misstating the share capital and ownership to mislead the VFSC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fraudulent declaration offences under the International Companies Act and general criminal law; VFSC may pursue strike-off, monetary penalties, and referral to the Public Prosecutor.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Piercing of the corporate veil; directors who sign false returns are personally liable for civil damages to creditors and shareholders, may be required to make restitution, face travel bans, and risk imprisonment for perjury or fraud.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion in Home Jurisdiction of Foreign Owner
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Vanuatu IC to conceal reportable business income from the beneficial owner's tax authorities (e.g., failing to report dividend distributions from Amazon Pay and Stripe settlements while claiming the IC is a discretionary structure).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu will exchange beneficial ownership and accounting information under the Global Forum peer-review mechanism upon lawful request; the foreign jurisdiction imposes its own evasion penalties, interest, and criminal prosecution independent of Vanuatu's zero-rate regime.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Foreign directors remain subject to personal criminal liability in the beneficial owner's residence state; travel bans, extradition requests, civil restitution, and imprisonment apply under foreign revenue law without any protection from Vanuatu tax exemption.
